days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: We can deliver La Sala Pentagrama for 48 primas with 10 delivery days, a fair deal ready to sign.
Propuesta justa para cerrar pronto: 30 P y 5 días.
Thanks! I can come down to 44 P with 10 delivery days. That's a fair middle ground we can close on.
Me muevo para acercarnos: 32 P con 5 días.
